findings.title: Floating-point arithmetic may cause rounding errors in deposit calculation
findings.body: The calculation `totalCents(booking) * (percent / 100)` uses floating-point arithmetic, which can introduce rounding errors. For financial calculations, this may lead to incorrect cent values. Use integer arithmetic or a fixed-point library to avoid precision loss.

findings.title: Unnecessary rounding step before conversion to cents
findings.body: The value `rounded` is rounded using `Math.round`, but `toCents` likely expects an integer. This extra rounding step is redundant and could be combined with the conversion to avoid an intermediate floating-point value.

summary.problem: The deposit calculation introduces potential floating-point rounding errors and an unnecessary rounding step.
summary.done_well: The new function `depositCents` is clearly named and integrates with existing utilities like `totalCents` and `toCents`.
